scope: Design-schema validation and in-memory four-paragraph text model ONLY; no proposed CLI execution.
semantic_model_cases: unchanged row still verifies before hash
changed working basis never restores old scaffold
overlapping literal starts count as ambiguous
overlapping literal occurrence 1 selects exact start
overlapping literal occurrence 2 selects exact start
NBSP is not normalized to ordinary space
unchanged rewrite retains attached comment declaration
unchanged replacement retains attached comment declaration
empty plan is valid unchanged request
missing expectation target is not passing absence
schema_negative_cases: source hash with trailing newline rejected
before hash with trailing newline rejected
expectation hash with trailing newline rejected
requirement key with trailing newline rejected
limitations: No actual DOCX mutation, revision settlement, tracking, comment-range construction, package preservation, publication failure handling, rendering or runtime conformance was tested. Attached comments are counted as declarations only. Working-basis drift is a string-model test.
